list_keyframes: list all keyframe timestamps from a video file using pyav container seeking
read_keyframes: read and decode keyframe data from a video file at specified timestamps
video_list_from_file: create a list of video file paths from a plain text file
read_keyframe_helper_data: read keyframe helper data from a CSV file with video_id and keyframes columns
VideoKeyframeDataset: build a PyTorch dataset that provides keyframes from a set of video files
